All Implemented Interfaces:
ca.uhn.fhir.model.api.IElement, Serializable, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBase, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseDatatype, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseElement, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseHasExtensions, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.ICompositeType
public class FhirContactPoint extends org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.ContactPoint
This class is a subclass of ContactPoint. Therefore it contains details about contact points for persons or organizations.
It contains functionalities for converting CDA R2 TEL into HL7 FHIR ContactPoint and vice versa.
